subject.title: fix: preserve steered audio for inbound TTS

question: Should this maintainer-owned PR remain the canonical operation-local fix after resolving current-main conflicts, or should the WhatsApp/TTS issue wait for a different state-boundary approach?
rationale: The code path is a real message-delivery fix, but the PR is protected/assigned and current main changed the same queueing surface after the branch head, so automation should not choose the final merge shape or proof bar alone.

options.title: Rebase And Keep Canonical
options.body: Resolve the current-main conflicts while preserving the operation-local marker, then use this PR as the landing path for the linked WhatsApp/TTS bug.

options.title: Require Live WhatsApp Proof
options.body: Keep the PR open but ask for a redacted real WhatsApp active-steer audio-to-voice run before merge.

options.title: Pause For Different Boundary
options.body: Pause this branch if maintainers prefer a broader reply-origin or session-metadata redesign instead of an operation-local marker.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Keep Canonical
recommendation.body: Resolve the current-main conflicts while preserving the operation-local marker, then use this PR as the landing path for the linked WhatsApp/TTS bug.
